controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: New Horizons observed terrain; southern darkness remains unavailable. Native detail varies across the map. The source already applies Lunar-Lambert photometric correction; local photographed terrain shadows remain.
controls.summary: Lighting is corrected, but local photographed shadows remain. Detail varies; the unobserved south is left unavailable.
controls.title: Monochrome mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Enhanced color combines MVIC near-infrared, red and blue bands, sharpened with panchromatic detail. It is not natural color or quantitative albedo. Gray grid marks missing color coverage; detail varies across the map.
controls.title: MVIC enhanced-color mosaic

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Measured topography relative to a 606 km sphere. Gray grid marks missing elevation. Stereo/shape-from-shading product; 300 m grid spacing is not uniform effective resolution.
controls.summary: Stereo and shading height relative to a 606 km sphere. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing data.
controls.title: Stereo and shading terrain model

controls.label: Bond albedo
controls.description: New Horizons photometric model estimating the fraction of sunlight reflected by Charon. Derived from LORRI brightness and scattering assumptions, not a direct bolometric measurement. Gray grid marks missing source cells and uncovered southern latitudes. Colors span 0.1–0.5; values beyond those limits use endpoint colors.
controls.title: New Horizons modeled Bond albedo
